name: sbb-lost-found
description: Enterprise-grade lost and found system for SBB Swiss public transport

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=services/reporting && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run build --workspace=@sbb-lost-found/types && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check:tenant
